name: sim_fiber_bundle_torch_foundation
description: Torch-native Fiber Bundle (Hopf) foundation: S³ total space, Hopf projection π: S³→S², fiber circles S¹, non-triviality, continuity — all torch float64 with autograd. numpy→torch migration proof-of-concept.

pytorch.reason: Hopf bundle S³ total space as 4-vector, projection π: S³→S² as Hopf map, fiber circles, normalization constraints — all torch float64 with autograd

z3.reason: UNSAT: |π(q)| > 1 ∧ |q|=1 impossible (Hopf projection has unit image on unit inputs)

cvc5.reason: z3 constraint solving sufficient for Hopf image norm UNSAT

sympy.reason: Symbolic Hopf map π(z₁,z₂)=(2Re(z₁z̄₂), 2Im(z₁z̄₂), |z₁|²-|z₂|²) and fiber dimension

clifford.reason: Clifford algebra not needed for Hopf bundle foundation

geomstats.reason: Riemannian geometry backend not needed for fiber migration

e3nn.reason: Equivariant neural networks not required for Hopf bundle sim

rustworkx.reason: Graph algorithms not applicable to fiber projections

xgi.reason: Hypergraph structure not needed for Hopf projection

toponetx.reason: Topological complexes not required for fiber bundle

gudhi.reason: Persistent homology not needed for Hopf foundation

P2_hopf_image_unit.description: Hopf projection of unit q gives ||π(q)|| ≤ 1

P3_hopf_maps_to_s2.description: Hopf projection maps S³ to S²

P4_fiber_circle.description: Fiber over base point forms a circle

P5_autograd_hopf_projection.description: Hopf projection is differentiable via pytorch autograd

P7_sympy_hopf_formula.description: sympy: Hopf map π(z₁,z₂) formula verified symbolically

P8_hopf_nontrivial.description: Hopf bundle is non-trivial (cannot extend section globally)

N2_non_unit_s3_detectable.description: Non-unit norm in S³ is detectable

N3_fiber_nonempty.description: Hopf fiber over any base point is non-empty

B1_poles_map_to_s2.description: North and south poles of S³ map to S²

migration_notes: This sim establishes the torch-native pattern for Fiber Bundle family migration. Next: port fiber bundle lego sims to use these primitives.
